title: Thailand Most Viral Vlogger
overview: Centered around a young tourist lad vlogging his way through Bangkok and Pattaya covering the most underrated subjects, trending rare things and unusual stories. From a new durian type, to an unknown snake fruit, to the cheapest yet high shelve weed strain in the market; a story of intrigue becomes the epitome of interest. A foodie reviewing thailand rare food, and fruits. A traveler exploring new, exciting things. And a passion for extreme sports and adventures. A vlog of huge emphasis, descriptive phases and a history of reviews in moderation.
